Rot's Passage is the first room of Uldir, consisting of a small chamber just inside the raid entrance where 7th Legion soldiers (for the Alliance) or Princess Talanji and her Rastari (for the Horde) wait, including a repair vendor (Garrick Blacksteel/Rovash the One Eyed). Just past it is the top of the Ruin's Descent elevator shaft where the first boss, Taloc, awaits.
The Rootwoven Strand is an area located in the Emerald Dream.

Rotfist is a mutated abomination sometimes located on the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn but will not be in phase until completion of Secure the Beach from the Isle of Dorn storyline. It escaped from Violet Hold after the crash of Dalaran alongside Kereke and Zovex, who share the spawn location.
Rotfist Flesh Carver drops from Rotfist at the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Rosy Sprat are fished up in Ratts' Revenge, while on the secret to obtain Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle. s are similar to , and rosy is red, so they're red herrings.

The Rotglow are a group of fungarians that have settled in Deepwalker Pass in Azj-Kahet. They reside in some of the caves there and appear to be rather peaceful, as they don't attack adventurers on sight. Like with many other fungarian groups in Khaz Algar, lashrooms can be observed living among them. They can be seen attacking a dead deepwalker outside the cave of The One Left.
Root Defender's Shield is a shield which is rewarded by completing the Lingering Shadows (achievement) questline.
Root Defender's Spear is a shield which is rewarded by completing the Lingering Shadows (achievement) questline.
Rotglow Settlers are fungarians located inside Deepwalker Pass in Azj-Kahet.
Roots of Trungal are lashrooms summoned by Trungal in the Chittering Den in the Ringing Deeps.
The Rooftop Raptor is a ravasaur located next to a mushroom on the roof of the Gallagio in the Undermine.
Roska's Wind Totem is a totem summoned by Archivist's Wind Totem in the Forbidden Reach.

Rosebud Gallywix is a goblin located at the Port Authority in the Undermine. Sahns and Dhunes work for him as security guards. Despite being the nephew of Jastor Gallywix, Marin Noggenfogger felt that he was a Gallywix in name only, and Rosebud had served as an apprentice to Monte Gazlowe. Following his uncle's death, Rosebud inherited the Gallagio, where during its grand reopening he was assassinated. Rusebud's killer was ultimately revealed to be Tarbonara Fizzlecrank, who was swiftly dealt with after the discovery.
Rotglow Sporeslingers are fungarians located inside Deepwalker Pass in Azj-Kahet.
Rotglow Pathkeepers are fungarians located inside Deepwalker Pass in Azj-Kahet.

A Rough Deepamethyst Shard can be looted from any purple Loose Crystal Shard in the Ringing Deeps. The purple Loose Crystal Shards' locations are: *North of the Hallowfall Gate *East of the Hallowfall Gate *Lost Mines This is one of the five shards required to open the Dusty Prospector's Chest in the basement of the inn in Gundargaz. The other four are the Rough Deepdiamond Shard, Rough Deepemerald Shard, Rough Deepruby Shard, and Rough Deeptopaz Shard.

The Rough Deepemerald Shard can be prospected from the Loose Crystal Shard at Nibelgaz Mine in the Ringing Deeps. It can be used along with the Rough Deepdiamond Shard, Rough Deepamethyst Shard, Rough Deepruby Shard and the Rough Deeptopaz Shard in order to open the Dusty Prospector's Chest in the basement of the inn in Gundargaz.

The blue Loose Crystal Shards' locations are: *Obsidian Hollow *Obsidian Hollow This is one of the five shards required to open the Dusty Prospector's Chest in the basement of the inn in Gundargaz. The other four are the Rough Deepamethyst Shard, Rough Deepemerald Shard, Rough Deepruby Shard, and Rough Deeptopaz Shard.

Rough Deeptopaz Shard can be prospected from the Loose Crystal Shard at Taelloch Mine in the Ringing Deeps. The Rotting Hole is a small cave located in the Stormtide Dregs near the southern end of the Siren Isle. It sits just southeast of the Drain. Normally, the cave itself is empty aside from being littered with bones. Two Darktide Aggressors spawn outside the entrance. During the Seafury Tempest phase, a Crystalline Memory of a Kul Tiran man can be seen cowering inside the cave, and a Torn Paper and a Runic Fragment sit beside him. Picking up the Runic Fragment causes the memory to fade away. Two Deepwater Eggtenders also spawn here.

The Rumbling Wastes is an abandoned mine since taken over by deepflayers, krolusks, and skardyn in central Ringing Deeps. The area is bordered by Shadowvein Point to the north, Obsidian Hollow to the west, Taelloch to the southeast, Camp Murroch to the south, the Cataract River to the west, and Pillarstone Spire to the northwest.

Rumshackle is a rock outcrop in east-central Hallowfall, filled with hornets and bats. The area is bordered by the Fungal Fields to the north, the Growling Hollow to the northeast, Dunelle's Kindness to the east, the Fangs to the south, and Cliffside Beacon and Gloomcrag Bower to the west.
Rumi of Gnomeregan is a great gnome mage. She is the author of Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works.
